2:
The chart titled "Progress toward carbon neutral" illustrates an emissions reduction pathway from 445 kg of baseline emissions[^7] minus 99 kg of emissions reductions, resulting in 346 kg of iMac emissions[^10]. 

The baseline bar totals 445 kg and consists of four segments: from largest to smallest, Materials and process emissions (largest), Electricity for product use, Electricity for manufacturing, and Transportation (smallest).

The emissions reductions column shows the reductions alongside the remaining emissions, highlighting reductions from:
- Recycled and low-carbon materials[^8] (reducing Materials and process emissions)
- Low-carbon electricity[^9] (reducing Electricity for manufacturing)
- Non-air shipping (reducing Transportation)
The Electricity for product use segment shows no reduction.

The final iMac emissions bar totals 346 kg and contains the reduced emissions segments: Materials and process emissions (largest), Electricity for product use (second largest), Electricity for manufacturing (third largest), Transportation (fourth largest), and a very thin segment labeled Renewable energy emissions[^11] at the bottom.
